metadata.title: NOUVELLES LETTRES SUR LA CHIMIE
metadata.title_complement: considérée dans ses applications à l'industrie, à la physiologie et à l'agriculture

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The main title "LA CHIMIE" exhibits the classic characteristics of the Didone style: a high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and small, unbracketed hair-line serifs. This style was highly prevalent in French printing during the early to mid-19th century.
